text:
maria: Quick sync — thinking about per-route telemetry sampling UI + compact saved views for cost-sensitive teams. Want to avoid surprises in analytics when teams turn sampling on/off. Anyone got quick takes?
kevin: +1. Two things: (1) sampling rate selector on the route page (global default + per-route override) (2) a preview that shows estimated token reduction and effect on retention/rollups.
ashley: Important: sampled data needs to be marked so rollups/percentiles are computed correctly. Saved views should persist sampling metadata, otherwise queries lie. Also quotas: sampled vs unsampled billing traces must be clear.
zac: Agreed. Implementation idea: attach a small sampling policy to each route config with overrides. Example config:```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.1  # 10%
  overrides:
    /chat: 1.0   # full capture for chat routes
    /embed: 0.05 # lower for embeddings
```
zac: Also suggested: allow temporary session-level overrides for canary rollouts (so canary customers can opt-in to 100% capture).
kevin: For the Console UX: propose a compact saved-view mode toggle "Include sampling context" that, when off, shows sampled metrics scaled to estimates and shows a badge "sampled". Also a small calc preview like: `estimated_tokens = observed_tokens / sampling_rate`.
ops-bot: deploybot: telemetry-sampling-service v1.3.4 deployed to staging at 1729004589 :white_check_mark:
ashley: UX note — saved queries need to snapshot the sampling policy (not just the UI toggle). Otherwise a saved view from 10% sampling could be loaded later when route is at 100% and produce inconsistent dashboards.
maria: Good catch. Action items: kevin -> prototype the selector + preview in console (mockups), zac -> extend route schema + add session override path, ashley -> doc telemetry semantics and tests for rollups. I'll own rollout plan.
kevin: I'll aim to drop a quick Figma by EOD tomorrow. cc: will add a little inline help copy: "Sampling reduces stored telemetry; metrics are estimated when sampled."
zac: I'll open a draft PR for route schema changes and include the example in comments.
ashley: I'll draft a short RFC and a test plan for aggregated metrics scaling and edge cases (e.g., low-volume routes).
maria: Sweet. Can we canary this in staging with a single team before beta? -> plan: staging canary next week, opt-in via session override. @eng-platform fyi. :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
zac: :rocket:
ops-bot: reminder: weekly metrics sync Thu 10:00am — we can walk through mockups there.
